fadaf72cf8.q: What does agentic shift mean for product design and workflow reimagining in organizations?
fadaf72cf8.a: The agentic shift is significant and probably more than other AI changes this year. Product is no longer a tool, so workflow has to be reimagined across different business units where you are not responding but it's much more integrated. Tools that are built for one box on the org chart lose their boundaries.

705325ce5c.q: Why is verification becoming a critical bottleneck in AI agent systems?
705325ce5c.a: Generating outputs is now becoming relatively cheap, but checking it is not. Someone needs to review what agents produce. In regulated sectors especially, we do need to keep critical human verification and validation of what is then going into systems in production.

8b477aa0aa.q: What is the difference between hierarchical and horizontal organizational models when managing multiple AI agents?
8b477aa0aa.a: If you run thirty agents on a single project or multiple projects, that person becomes a bottleneck. The question is whether the human is in a consulting mind like a senior partner with final say, or if the organization becomes one with a series of very senior people, so less hierarchical and much more flat horizontal.
